Date: 28/10/2026 
 
To, 
 
 
 
 
 
To, 
BSE Limited  
 
 
 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Corporate Relationship Department, 
Exchange Plaza 5th Floor, Plot no. C/1, 
25th Floor, P J Towers, Dalal Street, 
G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, 
Fort, Mumbai – 400001. 
 
 
Bandra (East), Mumbai – 400051. 
SCRIP CODE: 544814 
 
 
SYMBOL: KNACK 
 
Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio recording of earnings call – Q2FY2027 – Unaudited Financial Results. 
 
We refer to our intimation dated October 23, 2026 informing about the earnings call with 
Investors and Analysts to be hosted by the Company on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 
12:00 P.M. (IST) to discuss the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and 
Consolidated) of the Company for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 
2026. 
 
In this connection, pursuant to the provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, the Company has conducted Q2 FY2027 earnings call 
Today i.e. Wednesday, October 28, 2026, and have uploaded the audio recording on the 
website of the Company which can be accessed at:    
 
https://knackpackaging.com/INV/Earnings_Call/Earnings_Call_Recording_Q2-2027.mp3 
  
You are requested to take the same on your records. 
 
Thanking you, 
Yours faithfully, 
For Knack Packaging Limited 
 
 
 
___________________ 
Ravikumar Pasi 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer

Encl.: As above
